s5.5-structure-input-rejected.note: The load does refuse the recipe: StructureInput#requireSettled throws, the ERROR line is logged and OKCore's JsonErrorCollector collects it (logContains passes). But at server start no errors file is written: JsonErrorCollector.writeToFile is only called from /okmodular reload (MachineryModule), and the collector's configDir is only set in RecipeLoader.reload. run/TESTING.md §5.5 expects the error in an errors file. Not fixed: the fix is in the mod's startup load path and the right file (json_errors.txt or structures/errors.txt) is a choice for the author.

fixes.summary: harvest_block's level gate read harvest tools before Forge had filled them (ForgeHooks not yet loaded on a fresh server), so obsidian passed harvestLevel 1
Same cause: iron ore read as toolless and passed the default harvestLevel 0

DurationParser folded a duration to a constant by evaluating it with a null context; count_blocks answers 0 there, so 'count_blocks(...) > 0 ? 40 : 400' became a fixed 400 and perTick never re-read it
